Beyond Vision raises over €28 million to scale drones and AI systems

Índico and Lince co-lead the round with ActiveCap participating, supporting manufacturing, R&D and international expansion.

Tech.eu ↗22 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

Funding industrial expansion

Portuguese unmanned-aircraft developer Beyond Vision raised over €28 million, according to an October 22 report. Índico Capital Partners and Lince Capital co-led, with existing investor ActiveCap participating. The company employs 150 people and serves civilian and military customers.

Hardware with cloud management

Founded in 2013, Beyond Vision moved from software into AI-powered drones and cloud-based management. Funding will strengthen operations and manufacturing while supporting algorithm research and new management-platform functions for security and critical-infrastructure monitoring.

Capacity targets remain unspecified

The NATO-registered supplier plans further international expansion, but the report gives no annual drone-production target, new order total or funding allocation breakdown. Financing supports the expansion plan; it does not establish that manufacturing goals have already been achieved.
